name: Dunabogdány (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Dunabogdány (a yellow and blue shield with a grapevine, ears of grain and waves) above a scroll inscribed DUNABOGDÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
